MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1
====================

Source:  https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@4.7.1/dist/maplibre-gl.{js,css}
License: BSD-3-Clause (https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/blob/v4.7.1/LICENSE.txt)

These files are vendored so the app starts and renders the map UI without
any network round-trip. Map *tiles* still need network; the bundled files
only cover the renderer + CSS.

To upgrade, replace both files with newer versions from unpkg (or the
official MapLibre GitHub release), rename the parent directory to match
the new version, and update vendor_dir in drivepulse_app/map/webkit.py
plus the two paths in drivepulse_app/map/map.html.
